name: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage to Schedule Tribe
benefit: An incentive of ₹8,00,000/- is provided to the married couple, i.e. ₹5,00,000/- for the bride and ₹3,00,000/- for the groom.
_eligibility_text:
1. The couple should be residents of Karnataka.
1. The couple should belong to the Hindu religion.
1. The total annual income of the couple should be less than ₹5,00,000/-.
1. The application should be submitted within 18 months of the marriage.
1. One spouse should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community and should be a resident of Karnataka.
1. The marriage should have been between: (a) An ST individual and a non-ST individual; (b) Two ST individuals.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 1st April 2019.
